items.text: Product section with name and URLs
items.evidence: What are the production, staging, and development URLs?
items.reason: Discovery questions and examples require the Product section to capture the product name and production/staging/dev URLs.

items.text: Risk Areas table with at least 3 entries
items.reason: The Risk Areas guidance mandates a table with columns and a minimum of three entries.

items.text: asking all 40 questions at once
items.reason: The document lists asking all questions at once as an anti-pattern and instructs walking section by section.

items.text: generic template without project specifics
items.reason: The document warns against leaving placeholders and inventing information, requiring evidenced project-specific values.

items.text: Risk Areas section empty or missing
items.reason: Skipping Risk Areas is listed as an anti-pattern; the section must be kept even without evidence.

items.text: Test Stack section populated with Playwright and Jest
items.evidence: `jest.config.*` | Unit test framework → populate Test Stack Unit
items.reason: Detection table instructs populating Test Stack E2E from playwright.config and Test Stack Unit from jest.config.

items.text: ask only about the unfilled sections
items.evidence: only about the unfilled sections, then update — preserve completed sections untouched.
items.reason: Workflow step 3 explicitly says to ask only about unfilled sections when placeholders remain.

items.text: re-ask questions about already-completed sections
items.reason: The document instructs preserving completed sections and asking only about gaps, the opposite of re-asking.

items.text: Which parts cause the most production incidents
items.evidence: Which parts cause the most production incidents?
items.reason: This question appears verbatim in the Risk Areas discovery questions.

items.text: Risk table with fewer than 3 entries
items.reason: The document requires at least three risk entries, so it does not model fewer.

items.text: recommending a comprehensive regression suite to the solo developer
items.reason: For solo/zero QA the document says no manual regression suite and to lean on low-barrier automation.

items.text: flat Tech Stack without distinguishing components
items.reason: The document instructs recording frontend, backend, database, and hosting separately.

items.text: unclear which tests run for which app
items.reason: Monorepo guidance requires noting which path filters gate which app's suite.

items.text: recommending tools beyond the zero-infra defaults
items.reason: Recommending tools beyond the Playwright + Vitest zero-infra default is listed as an anti-pattern.

items.text: no guidance on what to do next
items.reason: The workflow ends by suggesting the next skill based on the context gaps.

items.text: 80% line coverage measured by Istanbul
items.reason: The document models this exact phrasing as how to write a measurable quality goal.

items.text: 90%+ coverage for early-stage startup
items.reason: The maturity table assigns 60% to early-stage startups and reserves 90%+ for enterprise.

items.text: recommending data-testid as only option
items.reason: The document defaults to data-testid but explicitly supports recording semantic/ARIA selectors with tradeoffs.

items.text: Risk Areas table has at least 3 entries
items.reason: Risk Areas guidance requires the table to contain a minimum of three entries.

items.text: at least 5 specific, testable key user flows
items.evidence: What are the 5–10 most critical user journeys?
items.reason: The document asks for 5–10 critical journeys and states key flows must be specific and testable.

items.text: generic template text still present
items.reason: Leaving template brackets in the final file is listed as an anti-pattern and checked in Verification.

items.text: missing URLs or environment names
items.reason: The document requires URLs and named environments in both Product and Environments sections.
